## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

| Command                       | Purpose                                                                          |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev`                 | `vite dev`, local dev server on `localhost:8080`                                 |
| `npm run build`               | `vite build`, Nitro build to `.output/` (preset `NITRO_PRESET` or `node-server`) |
| `npm run build:dev`           | `vite build --mode development`                                                  |
| `npm run start`               | `node .output/server/index.mjs`, production SSR server on `PORT=3000`            |
| `npm run preview`             | `vite preview`, serve built output                                               |
| `npm run lint`                | `eslint .`                                                                       |
| `npm run format`              | `prettier --write .`                                                             |
| `npm run smoke`               | `node scripts/smoke.mjs`, HTTP smoke test of lead endpoints and routes           |
| `npm run smoke -- --tracking` | Smoke test with tracking checks                                                  |
| `npm run assets:download`     | `node scripts/download-assets.mjs`, fetch binaries for `*.asset.json` stubs      |

- Tests: none configured (no test script, no test files).
- Coverage: none configured.
- `npm run smoke` is a plain Node HTTP script, not a test-runner suite. Run `npm run build && npm run smoke` first.
- CI: `.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml` runs on push to `main` and `workflow_dispatch`; it only POSTs the Coolify deploy API. CI runs no build, lint or test.

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

Full rules: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

| Rule                                                                                                    | Enforcement                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| TypeScript ^5.8.3, `strict: true`, target ES2022, moduleResolution Bundler                              | `tsconfig.json`                                                                    |
| Prettier: `printWidth` 100, semicolons, double quotes, `trailingComma` all                              | `.prettierrc`; `eslint-plugin-prettier/recommended` in `eslint.config.js`          |
| Prettier ignores listed paths                                                                           | `.prettierignore`                                                                  |
| ESLint 9 flat config: typescript-eslint, react-hooks, react-refresh, prettier plugin                    | `eslint.config.js`; `npm run lint`                                                 |
| `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` is off                                                              | `eslint.config.js`                                                                 |
| Import of the `server-only` package is banned; use `*.server.ts` or `@tanstack/react-start/server-only` | `eslint.config.js` (`no-restricted-imports`)                                       |
| `@/*` alias resolves to `src/*`                                                                         | `tsconfig.json` `paths`; `vite-tsconfig-paths`                                     |
| Build preset: `process.env.NITRO_PRESET \|\| "node-server"` (standalone Node, not Cloudflare Workers)   | `vite.config.ts`                                                                   |
| Class names merge with `cn` from `src/lib/utils.ts`                                                     | none (observed)                                                                    |
| UI primitives in `src/components/ui/` (shadcn/Radix); landing sections in `src/components/landing/`     | none (observed)                                                                    |
| Routes are TanStack file-based routes in `src/routes/`; root layout is `src/routes/__root.tsx`          | none (observed)                                                                    |
| Do not hand-edit `src/routeTree.gen.ts` (generated)                                                     | `.prettierignore` (excluded from Prettier)                                         |
| No `src/pages` or `app/layout.tsx`; keep `<Outlet />` in `src/routes/__root.tsx`                        | `src/routes/README.md`; `src/routes/__root.tsx` L169-170                           |
| Favicon links: `/favicon.ico`, `/favicon.png`, `/apple-touch-icon.png`                                  | `src/routes/__root.tsx` L120-122                                                   |
| Lead payload contract: zod `leadSchema` and `SERVICE_OPTIONS` in `src/lib/lead-schema.ts`               | none (observed)                                                                    |
| LP copy and business config live in `src/components/landing/site-data.ts`                               | none (observed)                                                                    |
| Static Black Friday LP lives in `public/blackfriday/` (plain HTML, CSS, JS; no TanStack route)          | Excluded from `npm run lint` (`eslint.config.js`) and Prettier (`.prettierignore`) |

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` before pushing; CI does not run them.
- Run `npm run build && npm run smoke` after changing lead endpoints or routes.
- Ask the user before adding `minimumReleaseAgeExcludes` entries to `bunfig.toml` (24h supply-chain guard, `bunfig.toml`).

### Never in this repository

- Force push, rebase, amend or squash commits already pushed to the connected branch (Lovable notice above).
- Push a broken `main`: every push syncs to Lovable and triggers the Coolify deploy (`.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml`).
- Commit real values for runtime env vars; `.env.example` holds names only ("Nunca commitar valores reais").
- Import the `server-only` package; ESLint blocks it (`eslint.config.js`).
- Re-add plugins bundled by `@lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config` (TanStack devtools, tanstackStart, viteReact, tailwindcss, tsConfigPaths, nitro) to `vite.config.ts`; the header says they break the build with duplicates (`vite.config.ts` L1-5).
- Edit `src/routeTree.gen.ts` (generated file).
- Import `.asset.json` stubs in components; import binaries from `@/assets/...` (`src/` has 0 `.asset.json` imports).

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

- Prereqs: Node 22 (`Dockerfile` uses `node:22-alpine`), npm (`package-lock.json`). `bun.lock` and `bunfig.toml` also present.
- Prereqs for Docker: Docker engine.

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
npm run assets:download
```

```sh
docker build -t lp-myteamrenovation .
docker run -p 3000:3000 lp-myteamrenovation
```

```sh
npm run build && npm run smoke -- --tracking
```

### Runtime env vars

Names in `.env.example`. Read at runtime (Coolify environment); changing a value needs redeploy, not rebuild.

| Variable                    | Effect when empty or missing                                                                                            |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL`          | `POST /api/lead` returns 503 `lead_destination_unavailable`; no lead delivered                                          |
| `BF_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL`       | `POST /blackfriday/api/lead` returns 503; visitor sees call-us fallback                                                 |
| `META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN`    | Meta CAPI disabled (needs `META_PIXEL_ID` and this token both set); browser Pixel keeps working                         |
| `META_CAPI_TEST_EVENT_CODE` | No `test_event_code` sent; when set, events go to Test Events (remove after validation)                                 |
| `META_PIXEL_ID`             | Root `/` Meta Pixel and CAPI disabled; `/blackfriday` Pixel unaffected (hardcoded in `public/blackfriday/js/config.js`) |
| `GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID`        | GA4 feature disabled                                                                                                    |
| `VSL_VIDEO_URL`             | VSL feature disabled                                                                                                    |

### Troubleshooting

| Symptom                                                     | Check                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST /api/lead` returns 503 `lead_destination_unavailable` | `LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL` unset in runtime env                                                                               |
| `/blackfriday` form shows call-us fallback                  | `BF_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL` unset or 503 from `POST /blackfriday/api/lead`                                                  |
| Dev lead webhook never responds                             | Dev URL uses `.../webhook-test/<id>`; responds only while n8n editor listens (`.env.example`)                         |
| SSR 500 shows HTML error page                               | Inspect `src/server.ts` and `src/lib/error-capture.ts`                                                                |
| Duplicate Vite plugin errors                                | Remove manually added plugins from `vite.config.ts` (header comment warns of duplicate plugins)                       |
| Meta CAPI events absent                                     | `META_PIXEL_ID` and `META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN` both set; `src/lib/meta-capi.server.ts` returns early if either is empty |
| `/blackfriday` Pixel ID wrong or not firing                 | Hardcoded in `public/blackfriday/js/config.js`; loads only off localhost (`public/blackfriday/js/main.js`)            |
| Missing `*.asset.json` stubs or images                      | `npm run assets:download`                                                                                             |
| Build targets Cloudflare Workers or wrong output            | Check `NITRO_PRESET` (default `node-server`; `vite.config.ts` L11)                                                    |

### Tips

- `META_CAPI_BASE_URL` overrides the Graph base URL for `npm run smoke` only (`src/lib/meta-capi.server.ts` L31); missing from `.env.example`.
- Build-time env: `NITRO_PRESET` (`Dockerfile` L12).
- CI secret name: `COOLIFY_API_TOKEN` (`.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml`).
- Production container: `HOST=0.0.0.0`, `PORT=3000` (`Dockerfile` L21-22).
- Lead flow: `src/lib/lead.server.ts` (main) and `src/lib/bf-lead.server.ts` (Black Friday) forward to n8n, then fire CAPI after 2xx.
